MAPPLET.DESCRIPTION:
This mapplet generate standardized address from Address Doctor
[ML 10/28/2020] Added logic to default state for all systems when address Dr returns null.
MAPPLET.NAME: mplt_Global_Addr_Validation

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Address_1
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE, (INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'STE #') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 4), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'STE #') - 1),
(INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'SUITE') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 4), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'SUITE') - 1),
(INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'STE.') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 3), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'STE.') - 1),
(INSTR(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1))), 'STE') = LENGTH(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)))) - 2), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_1)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_1), 'STE') - 1),
in_Address_1 )

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Address_2
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE, REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)STE #$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'STE #') - 1),
REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)SUITE$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'SUITE') - 1),
REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)STE\.$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'STE.') - 1),
REG_MATCH(in_Address_2, '.*(?i)STE$'), SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_Address_2)), 1, INSTR(UPPER(in_Address_2), 'STE') - 1),
in_Address_2 )

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Src_Sys_Out
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(ISNULL(Src_sys),'TRS',SRC_SYS) -- Use TIERS State conversion is a conversion table is not specified

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Token Standardizer stdr_City_Name rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: stdr_City_Name

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Reference table ref_Valid_City: any value -> valid value
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: lkp_ref_Valid_City

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT CITY_NM AS VALID_VALUE, UPPER(CITY_NM) AS MATCH_VALUE FROM ref_Valid_City133231612434 WHERE CITY_NM IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CITY_NM AS VALID_VALUE, UPPER(CITY_NM1) AS MATCH_VALUE FROM ref_Valid_City133231612434 WHERE CITY_NM1 IS NOT NULL

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Token Standardizer stdr_Name_Correction rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: stdr_Name_Correction

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Case Converter Case_Converter rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: rule_Addr_Line_Pre_Scrub1_Case_Converter

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Token Standardizer std_Remove_Junk_Characters rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: rule_Addr_Line_Pre_Scrub1_std_Remove_Junk_Characters

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Token Standardizer std_Replace_Hash_and_Slash rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: rule_Addr_Line_Pre_Scrub1_std_Replace_Hash_and_Slash

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: City_Out
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(Substr(Src_sys,1,1) = 'P' and length(City_Orig) = 12 ,City_Stdz -- Pfiles frequently have cities truncated at 12 bytes, use corrected version ,City_Orig)

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: PLACEHOLDER for the IDQ Address Validator: replace with a CDQ Address Verifier (see conversion_report.md). Echoes the input address; status fields are NULL.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: dq_Global_AddressValidation_Hybrid

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_County
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode(True, State = '48',County, ISNULL(County), --Unknown State '999', --996 is out of State '996')

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Lattd
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode(TRUE, NOT ISNULL(GeoCodingLatitude) AND RTRIM(GeoCodingLatitude) <> '', TO_DECIMAL(LTRIM(RTRIM(GeoCodingLatitude))), ISNULL(GeoCodingLatitude) or GeoCodingLatitude='',0, TO_DECIMAL(LTRIM(RTRIM(GeoCodingLatitude))))

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Lngtd
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
Decode(TRUE, NOT ISNULL(GeoCodingLongitude) AND RTRIM(GeoCodingLongitude) <> '', TO_DECIMAL(LTRIM(RTRIM(GeoCodingLongitude))),
ISNULL(GeoCodingLatitude) or GeoCodingLatitude='',0, TO_DECIMAL(LTRIM(RTRIM(GeoCodingLatitude))))

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Out_Address_1
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
--Modified by Max 5/01/2016 - changed to po box field having len > 0 RTRIM(LTRIM( IIF( LENGTH(RTRIM(AddressElementsPostalPhraseComplete1)) >0 and LENGTH(RTRIM(StreetCompleteWithNumber1)) =0 , AddressElementsPostalPhraseComplete1, IIF( LENGTH(RTRIM(AddressElementsPostalPhraseComplete1))>0 AND LENGTH(RTRIM(Sub_buildingComplete1))>0 ,RTRIM(StreetCompleteWithNumber1) ||' '||Sub_buildingComplete1, StreetCompleteWithNumber1 ) ) ))
--ORIGINAL CODE --RTRIM(LTRIM( IIF( LENGTH(RTRIM(LTRIM(AddressElementsPostalPhraseComplete1))) > --0 and ISNULL(StreetCompleteWithNumber1) OR LENGTH(RTRIM(StreetCompleteWithNumber1)) =0 , AddressElementsPostalPhraseComplete1, StreetCompleteWithNumber1 )))

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Out_Address_2
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(LENGTH(RTRIM(AddressElementsPostalPhraseComplete1)) > 0 and LENGTH(RTRIM(StreetCompleteWithNumber1))>0 , AddressElementsPostalPhraseComplete1, REPLACESTR(1, RTRIM(LTRIM( BuildingComplete1||' '|| BuildingComplete2||' '|| Sub_buildingComplete1||' '|| Sub_buildingComplete2 )), ' ',' '))

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_State_code
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: DECODE(TRUE, -- Use Addr Dr State if valued NOT (ISNULL(Address_Doctor_State_code) or Address_Doctor_State_code ='' or IS_SPACES(Address_Doctor_State_code)) , Address_Doctor_State_code -- Else Use source sytems state ,NOT (ISNULL(in_State_code) or in_State_code ='' or IS_SPACES(in_State_code)), in_State_code -- Else default Texas based on zip code ,Zip_cd_5 = '73301' OR (Zip_cd_5 >= '75001' and Zip_cd_5 <= '79999' AND Zip_cd_5 <> '75502') OR (Zip_cd_5 >= '88510' AND Zip_cd_5 <= '88589') ,'48' -- else null ,NULL) --LTRIM(RTRIM(in_State_code)), --Address_Doctor_State_code)

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Token Standardizer std_Bad_Data rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: rule_Addr_Line_Post_Scrub1_std_Bad_Data
